tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search active listings. Free. Returns previews (id, category, title, price) without contact details; use get_listing for the full record.

tools.name: publish_listing
tools.description: Publish a listing. Free, rate limited. Prices are in USDC. contact_type 'mcp' or 'http' needs an https:// URL; 'wallet' needs a 0x EVM address.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one full listing including contact details. PAID via x402 ($0.50 USDC): the call returns a payment-required error until an x402 payment is attached to the request _meta. Clients without x402 support can use the same price over plain HTTP: GET https://api.easyrider.one/listings/{listing_id} with

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_listing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get one full listing including contact details. PAID via x402 ($0.01 USDC): the call returns a payment-required error until an x402 payment is attached to the request _meta. Clients without x402 support can use the same price over plain HTTP: GET https://api.easyrider.one/listings/{listing_id} with " → after: "Get one full listing including contact details. PAID via x402 ($0.50 USDC): the call returns a payment-required error until an x402 payment is attached to the request _meta. Clients without x402 support can use the same price over plain HTTP: GET https://api.easyrider.one/listings/{listing_id} with "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
